# Books and learning

Books, quotes, courses and reading lists, boiled down to a post.

17 templates. Square brackets are placeholders: replace every one before you post.

## Books worth your time (`hBooks`)

- Network: any network
- Use it when: Most books on a topic repeat each other. Name the few that do not.

```text
Most books about [topic] could have been a blog post.

These could not:

• [title]: [why it is worth it]
• [title]: [why it is worth it]
• [title]: [why it is worth it]

Which one would you add?
```

## I read them so you do not have to (`hBooksRead`)
